description: Figure: domain maps of AVT1-7 with [DE]xxxL[LI] positions, plus positive-control validation of the motif scan
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re, requests, time

ACC = {"AVT1":"P47082","AVT2":"P39981","AVT3":"P36062","AVT4":"P50944",
       "AVT5":"P38176","AVT6":"P40074","AVT7":"P40501"}
full={g:requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json() for g,a in ACC.items()}
SEQ={g:j["sequence"]["value"] for g,j in full.items()}
TMs={g:[(f["location"]["start"]["value"],f["location"]["end"]["value"]) for f in j.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Transmembrane"] for g,j in full.items()}
pat=re.compile(r'(?=([DE]...L[LI]))')

order=["AVT1","AVT2","AVT3","AVT4","AVT5","AVT6","AVT7"]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,9),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2.1,1]})

ax=axes[0]
for k,g in enumerate(order):
    y=len(order)-k; s=SEQ[g]; L=len(s); tm=TMs[g]
    n_end=tm[0][0]-1; c_start=tm[-1][1]+1
    ax.plot([1,L],[y,y],color="#b8bdc4",lw=2,zorder=1)
    ax.plot([1,n_end],[y,y],color="#3a6ea5",lw=7,solid_capstyle="butt",zorder=2)
    if c_start<=L: ax.plot([c_start,L],[y,y],color="#2e9e6b",lw=7,solid_capstyle="butt",zorder=2)
    for a_,b_ in tm: ax.plot([a_,b_],[y,y],color="#d9822b",lw=11,solid_capstyle="butt",zorder=3)
    for m in pat.finditer(s):
        p=m.start(1)+1
        ax.plot(p,y+0.30,marker="v",color="#c0392b",ms=9,zorder=4)
        ax.text(p,y+0.44,m.group(1),ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=7,color="#c0392b")
    ax.text(-28,y,g,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=11,fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(L+10,y,f"N-tail {n_end} aa / C-tail {max(0,L-c_start+1)} aa",va="center",fontsize=8,color="#55595f")
ax.set_xlim(-200,900); ax.set_ylim(0.3,7.9); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("residue position")
ax.set_title("AVT1-AVT7 (S. cerevisiae): no [DE]xxxL[LI] motif lies in any terminal cytosolic tail\n"
             "blue = N-terminal tail, orange = UniProt predicted TM, green = C-terminal tail, red triangle = [DE]xxxL[LI] match",
             fontsize=11,loc="left")
for sp in ("top","right","left"): ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

ax2=axes[1]
ctrls={"Vam3 (yeast AP-3 cargo, PMID 9722605)":("Q12241",261,"cytosolic 1-261"),
       "Pho8/ALP (yeast AP-3 cargo, PMID 9564031)":("P11491",33,"cytosolic 1-33"),
       "LIMP-2/SCARB2 human (PMID 14691137)":("Q14108",478,"C-tail 460-478"),
       "Tyrosinase human":("P14679",529,"C-tail 498-529")}
labels=[];vals=[];cols=[]
for nm,(a,lim,note) in ctrls.items():
    s=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
    time.sleep(0.15)
    if "C-tail" in note:
        st=int(note.split()[1].split("-")[0]); sub=s[st-1:]
    else: sub=s[:lim]
    h=[m.group(1) for m in pat.finditer(sub)]
    labels.append(f"{nm}\n({note})"); vals.append(len(h)); cols.append("#2e9e6b" if h else "#c0392b")
for g in order:
    s=SEQ[g]; tm=TMs[g]; n_end=tm[0][0]-1; c_start=tm[-1][1]+1
    sub=s[:n_end]+s[c_start-1:]
    labels.append(f"{g}\n(both terminal tails)"); vals.append(len(list(pat.finditer(sub)))); cols.append("#c0392b")
ax2.bar(range(len(vals)),vals,color=cols)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(labels))); ax2.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=7,rotation=30,ha="right")
ax2.set_ylabel("[DE]xxxL[LI] matches\nin cytosolic tail")
ax2.set_yticks([0,1,2]); ax2.set_ylim(0,2.4)
ax2.set_title("Positive controls recover the motif; all seven AVT paralogs score zero",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for sp in ("top","right"): ax2.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
